Agent Name: WebServing_Expert
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: Misidentified the landmark on the August 2021 Vogue cover as the White House. The cover features Jill Biden at the White House grounds with the Washington Monument visible behind trees; the task asks for the monument’s height, which is 555 feet (about 185 yards). Using the White House’s height (70 feet) led to the incorrect answer of 23 yards.
